text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I had the privilege of observing you,
and it was so educational...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Above all else, the trust between the two of you
is truly wonderful……!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry for holding you up when you're tired!
Well then, excuse me!
